description: Source code for the TrafficSeparationTask class managing traffic separation, VLAN configuration, and WDS interface handling in a network agent.

classes.name: TrafficSeparationTask
classes.description: Manages traffic separation, VLAN configuration, and WDS interface handling within the network agent.

methods.name: cleanup_ts_runtime_state
methods.description: Cleans up runtime state related to traffic separation, including configuration and VLAN settings.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles various traffic separation related events and schedules corresponding actions.

methods.name: stronger_mode
methods.description: Determines the stronger (higher priority) apply mode between two modes.

methods.name: schedule_apply
methods.description: Schedules a traffic separation configuration application with a specified mode.

methods.name: should_run_now
methods.description: Checks if the scheduled work should run immediately based on timing and pending state.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Performs scheduled traffic separation work based on the current mode.

methods.name: clear_configuration
methods.description: Clears current WDS interfaces and resets the traffic separation manager.

methods.name: ensure_transport_primary_vlan
methods.description: Configures the primary VLAN for transport if needed.

methods.name: reset_transport_monitoring_on_bridge
methods.description: Resets transport monitoring on the network bridge.

methods.name: build_ts_config
methods.description: Builds traffic separation configuration based on database settings.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the entire traffic separation configuration, including VLANs, ports, and policies.

methods.name: handle_new_sta_iface
methods.description: Handles the addition of new station interfaces to the traffic separation configuration.

methods.name: handle_clear_sta_iface
methods.description: Handles the removal of station interfaces from the traffic separation configuration.

methods.name: collect_current_wds_ifaces
methods.description: Collects current WDS interfaces and their untagged mode status.

methods.name: add_backhaul_connection_trunk
methods.description: Adds backhaul connection trunk based on the current backhaul configuration.

methods.name: collect_ports_from_db
methods.description: Collects trunk and access ports from the database for traffic separation.

methods.name: sta_index_for_prefix
methods.description: Extracts station index from interface name prefix.

methods.name: get_all_sta_ifaces_for_bss
methods.description: Retrieves all station interfaces associated with a given BSS interface.
